title: cortad.json
description: What a run needs to know about an app: where to send a message, where the reply is, and the rules the app is supposed to keep.

app.description: One sentence on what this app does for the people who use it.

url.description: Where a message is sent. {{thread}} is replaced by a fresh id per conversation.

body.description: The request this endpoint takes. Put {{message}} where the user's words go, or {{messages}} where the whole turn list goes.

reply.description: Where the reply sits in the answer, as dotted keys and array indexes: choices.0.message.content

rules.description: Every rule this app is supposed to keep, in the words its own prompt uses.

users.description: Who uses this app, one sentence each.
